excerpt: Most arcade machine ROI claims online are vague or unsupported. This article models three explicit scenarios anchored to a real $4,250 machine price, shows payback ranging from 6 years to under 1 year depending on venue type and traffic, and calculates the net monthly profit after the machine pays for itself.
